title: Lead and Asbestos Planning Time in Mold Remediation Work Plans
content:
Operations standard for Mold Remediation work plans written where regulated materials have already been found during the water loss. The linked Water Damage Mitigation job is judged as its records stood on the mold job's opened date, the day of the visit.

When the linked water job carries a lead-safe setup line dated on or before the opened date, the lead-safe planning hours of 1.0 hour are added to the work-plan visit hours. When it carries no such lead-safe setup line but carries an asbestos sampling line dated on or before the opened date, the asbestos planning hours of 0.75 hours are added. Every other job adds no regulated-material hours.

| Charge lines on the linked water job, dated on or before the mold job's opened date | Hours added |
|---|---|
| Lead-safe setup line (with or without an asbestos sampling line) | 1.0 lead-safe planning |
| Asbestos sampling line, no lead-safe setup line | 0.75 asbestos planning |
| Neither | None |
| No linked water job | None |

Hypothetical: a water job whose lead-safe setup line is dated 12 June. A mold job opened on 12 June adds 1.0 hour; a mold job opened on 11 June finds no lead-safe setup line dated on or before its opened date, and adds 0.75 hours only if that water job carries an asbestos sampling line dated on or before 11 June.
